testCases.title: User can browse and join a public channel
preconditions: User is logged in
At least 3 public channels exist
steps: Verify channel list displays with name, topic, and member count
Tap a channel the user has not joined
testCases.expectedResult: User is added as a member. Channel thread is displayed. Channel appears in joined list with joined indicator.
testCases.linkedStory: Browse and join a public channel

testCases.title: User can send a text message and see it delivered
preconditions: User is a member of a channel
A second test user is connected to the same channel
steps: Type 'AAPL holding above 225 support, looks constructive' in compose box
Verify second user's client receives the message
testCases.expectedResult: Message appears in sender's thread within 500ms. Message appears on second user's client within 500ms. Timestamp is displayed.
testCases.linkedStory: Send and receive text messages in a channel

testCases.title: Message delivery latency is under 500ms at p95
preconditions: Load test environment with 5,000 simulated concurrent WebSocket connections
steps: Send 1,000 messages across 50 channels using load test tool
Measure end-to-end delivery time from send to receipt on subscriber
Calculate p50, p95, and p99 latencies
testCases.expectedResult: p50 < 100ms. p95 < 500ms. p99 < 1,000ms. No message loss.
testCases.linkedStory: Send and receive text messages in a channel

testCases.title: User can attach a ticker card to a message
preconditions: User is a member of a channel
AAPL is a valid symbol
steps: Tap the ticker-card icon in the compose toolbar
Add text 'My entry target:' to the compose box
testCases.expectedResult: Message appears in thread with text and an embedded AAPL ticker card showing current price and intraday % change.
testCases.linkedStory: Share a live ticker card in a message

testCases.title: Ticker card price updates every 15 seconds
preconditions: A message with an AAPL ticker card is visible in a channel during market hours
steps: Observe ticker card showing initial price
testCases.expectedResult: Ticker card price is refreshed to reflect the current market price within 15 seconds. Change % updates accordingly.
testCases.linkedStory: Share a live ticker card in a message

testCases.title: Tapping a ticker card navigates to instrument detail screen
preconditions: A message with a ticker card is visible in a channel thread
steps: Tap the ticker card in the message
testCases.expectedResult: User is navigated to the TradeEasy instrument detail screen for the tapped symbol.
testCases.linkedStory: Share a live ticker card in a message

testCases.title: Message over 2,000 characters is rejected
preconditions: User is composing a message in a channel
steps: Paste or type 2,001 characters in the compose box
testCases.expectedResult: Character counter turns red and shows 'Over limit — 2,000 character maximum'. Send button is disabled. Message is not sent.
testCases.linkedStory: Send and receive text messages in a channel

testCases.title: Rate limiting prevents message spam
preconditions: User is in a channel
steps: Send 30 short messages in quick succession
Attempt to send a 31st message within the same 60-second window
testCases.expectedResult: After the 30th message, a toast appears: 'Slow down — you're sending messages too quickly'. Send is blocked for 10 seconds.
testCases.linkedStory: Send and receive text messages in a channel

testCases.title: Message history loads when opening a channel
preconditions: A channel has at least 50 existing messages
steps: Open a channel with message history
Measure time for last 50 messages to render
testCases.expectedResult: Last 50 messages displayed within 1 second. Messages are in chronological order (oldest at top, newest at bottom).
testCases.linkedStory: Load message history on channel open

testCases.title: Infinite scroll loads older message history
preconditions: A channel has more than 50 messages
steps: Open a channel and allow initial 50 messages to load
Scroll to the top of the loaded messages
testCases.expectedResult: When the top of the loaded list is reached, the previous 50 messages load automatically. Scroll position is preserved.
testCases.linkedStory: Load message history on channel open

testCases.title: Blocked keyword in message is held for moderation
preconditions: User is in a channel
Moderation blocklist contains test pattern
steps: Send a message containing a blocked keyword
Check if other members can see the message
testCases.expectedResult: Sender sees 'Your message is under review'. Message does not appear in the thread for other members.

testCases.title: Compliance reviewer can approve a held message
preconditions: A message is in the compliance review queue
steps: Reviewer taps Approve on the held message
testCases.expectedResult: Message is delivered to the channel thread retroactively. Sender receives notification 'Your message has been approved'.

testCases.title: Pump-and-dump velocity detection triggers hold
preconditions: A channel is active
steps: Send 11 messages referencing the same ticker within 5 minutes in a single channel (via test harness)
Attempt to send a 12th message referencing the same ticker
testCases.expectedResult: The 12th message is held for review. A notice appears: 'High message volume detected for this ticker — your message is under review'.

testCases.title: User can create a new public channel
preconditions: User is on the channel list screen
steps: Enter name 'nvda-bulls' and topic 'NVIDIA earnings and AI news'
testCases.expectedResult: Channel is created. User is auto-joined as founder. Channel appears in the channel list. Other users can discover and join it.

testCases.title: Duplicate channel name is rejected
preconditions: Channel 'aapl-watchers' already exists
testCases.expectedResult: Inline error: 'A channel with this name already exists'. Channel is not created.

testCases.title: User can leave a channel
preconditions: User is a member of a channel
testCases.expectedResult: User is removed from the channel. Channel no longer appears in joined list. Member count decrements by 1. Message history is preserved.

testCases.title: All messages are written to archive within 1 hour
preconditions: Archive pipeline is running
Test messages are sent
steps: Query compliance archive API for those messages
testCases.expectedResult: All 10 messages appear in the archive with correct channel_id, user_id, content, and created_at. Moderation status is included.
testCases.linkedStory: Messages are archived for 7-year MiFID II retention

testCases.title: Compliance team can search archived messages by user and date range
preconditions: Messages exist in the archive for user-123
testCases.expectedResult: Response contains all messages sent by user-123 in the specified date range. Results are returned within 30 seconds. Each record includes: message_id, channel_id, user_id, content, ticker_ref, created_at, moderation_status.
testCases.linkedStory: Messages are archived for 7-year MiFID II retention
